attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

hotels = search_hotels(

    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
    num_people=4,
    stars=[5],
    budget=70,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache

# Find the nearest attractions to the hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Output the query summary
